requirement: R13 wave 2 batch: four read routes through the S26d pattern with shared client/renderer

sharedSurface.client: createReadbackClients(options) builds one injectable-fetch reader per route; shared accept/Authorization-only-when-token/cache-no-store/signal forwarding.
sharedSurface.command: defineReadReadback (one Command, key + token, per-route readers) in src/commands.ts.
sharedSurface.renderer: renderReadbackPage(spec,state,h) renders shared success/empty/loading/error DOM with per-route labels; per-route wrappers only supply parsers/specs.

states: Each route: success rows; empty text; loading with aria-busy; error role=alert with exact phrase listed above. Routes are data reads; all four states apply.
refresh: One fetch-count test per route; each uses the shell's existing single runtime subscription (revision.update) and never creates a second source.
clientContract: Shared client test asserts all four host paths in order, GET, authorization bearer only when provisioned, and abort signal identity.
